source: (text, request, material) => { const names = material.map(m => m.name.toLowerCase()); const m = text.match(/## Facts\s*\n([\s\S]*?)(?=\n## |$)/i); if (!m) return null; const body = m[1]; const sentences = body.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => /[A-Za-z0-9]/.test(s)); const spans = []; for (const s of sentences) { const cites = [...s.matchAll(/\[([^\]]+)\]/g)].map(x => x[1].trim().toLowerCase()); const ok = cites.length > 0 && cites.every(c => names.includes(c)); if (!ok) { const idx = text.indexOf(s); spans.push({ start: Math.max(0, idx), end: Math.max(0, idx) + s.length, why: 'fact sentence without a bracketed citation to a document in the file' }); } } return { ok: spans.length === 0, detail: spans.length ? spans.length + ' uncited fact sentence(s)' : 'every fact cites a file document', spans }; }
means: Each sentence in the Facts section carries a bracketed citation, and each cited name is a document in the material.
